_example.note: Shape modeled on the deployed geocoder byCoord/importGeoInfo source inspected 2026-09-20 (docs/architecture/deployed-lambda-excerpts.md); values are invented. Every field is conditional on the provider/cache record. /geocode/v000903/addr/... responses have the same shape without kmaAddress. name/address language follows the request Accept-Language. The Angular client resolves this body directly, stores name/address/country/location and never reads kmaAddress; the weather Lambda uses kmaAddress to build the KMA backend path. _example is documentation metadata outside the API body.
